scope: Private M-04 speed investigation; source evidence, not runtime certification

rejectedCandidate.name: Explicit low-complexity OpenH264 setting
rejectedCandidate.reason: Already the pinned default. FFmpeg invokes GetDefaultParams, which calls FillDefault, which sets LOW_COMPLEXITY. Neither FFmpeg nor our private wrapper changes iComplexityMode. Adding the same setting is not a distinct optimization.

upstreamSources.finding: Raw source line 142 sets the default complexity to LOW_COMPLEXITY; ParamTranscode copies the supplied complexity.
Raw source lines 175-177 implement GetDefaultParams by invoking SWelsSvcCodingParam::FillDefault.
Raw source line 133 invokes GetDefaultParams; the wrapper contains no complexity AVOption or iComplexityMode assignment. This hash equals the original-source guard in our build recipe.

nextCandidate.name: Whole-library link-time optimization
nextCandidate.implementation: Opt-in WITHIN_H264_LIBRARY_LTO=1 adds -flto to OpenH264 C/C++ and FFmpeg compile/link flags; the existing final link already uses -flto. Default remains 0.
nextCandidate.requiredComparison: Same genuine 105000218-byte 60s 1280x720/30fps input and codec settings; independently validate frames/timestamps/AAC/metadata/SSIM, complete-process memory and cleanup. Compare default against LTO with repeated runs. No public adoption without all original gates.
